pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-tan regions with soft edge gradients and rounded vertices; relative spatial area of patches is significantly greater than the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, cream-colored interstitial network with high-pixel-width pathways; junctions are clearly defined as tri-radial nodes forming a continuous topological web.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck ridge formed by short, dense, upright hairs against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small birds (Oxpeckers) with dark plumage and distinct yellow/red bills perched on the dorsal ridge and lower limbs of the subject.
